items.value: Where did I put it...
I couldn't use it as a hanger... or could I?
What if Tomegeb took her? He somehow stole my treats...
Not now, I'm busy!
Hello, Guinevere Gimlina.
Don't bother me, I'm busy... oh, Alik? Why are you so gloomy? I didn't even recognize you at first!
So why should I be happy? Nothing good ever happens to me...
Okay! Now don't be sad! Better help me with something, because I have so much work that I can't keep up.
Work is not a wolf; it won't run away into the forest.
Work is no big deal, but your granny, when she's angry, is a real pain! Come on, Alik, come on, my dear, come on, help me, please!
Oh... okay, there's nothing else to do anyway, so be it, I'll help!
Thank you, Alik! You're a true friend! If it helps, I... I think I was by the watermill when I first started cleaning... maybe you could look there first?
Sometimes help, sometimes do, sometimes remember, sometimes go for a walk... Even dragons didn't chase me like that.
I'm so tired... I don't have the strength for all this.
Gvinka hasn't changed a bit over the years, she's a workaholic.
Yes, she started cleaning, but apparently forgot to finish... maybe I can follow the tracks and find where she left the broom?
Big deal, making a platinum knight look for a broom! What nonsense!
I don't feel like doing anything...
Yeah, she was here all this time. And how could anyone forget a magical cleansing artifact?
Guinevere Gimlina, your broom has been found! A two-thousand-strong broom, just as you ordered!
Oh, Alik, thank you so much, my darling! Give it to me, now I...
(crunch)
Oh, my back! Damn sciatica, damn it... I'll sit for a bit, and then I'll get to work,
Oh... no, you can't work in this state. And anyway, you've been so worried today, running around, trying so hard. Get some rest, and I'll clean everything up.
Well, Alik, but I...
No "buts"!
Oh... just be careful! I haven't cleaned the basement in a while, you never know what might happen...
Well, I'll clean everything.
Well, I can't force her to work in this state. I'll help, what can I do?
I used to work like that in the Order too. It's crazy.
Take that dust elemental, lich! I have to stay away from him, otherwise he'll give me an allergic reaction.
